hero.tagline: Cybersecurity Student • CTF Player • RE & Forensics

bio: I'm a passionate cybersecurity student diving deep into the world of digital security. My journey started with curiosity about how systems work under the hood, which led me to explore reverse engineering, malware analysis, and digital forensics.

Through competing in CTF challenges and hands-on practice, I've developed skills in binary exploitation, web security, and forensic investigation. I love the thrill of breaking down complex systems and understanding their inner workings.
When I'm not breaking things (ethically!), you'll find me creating tech content, playing chess, or diving into the latest security research papers.
